testing_gaps: The calibrated production path is not covered end to end: test_camera_isp_quality.py checks malformed/missing calibration and _apply_color_gains directly, but never opens a valid calibration and captures. Add a valid temporary calibration test asserting stored gains, sensor exposure/gain, and decoded JPEG color on a synthetic white/pale-yellow page; this guards against production silently using neutral gains while the helper test still passes.

The new highlight cap in _capture_batch_adaptive has no behavioral test. Add a mocked dark batch containing a near-white patch and assert no higher-gain recapture, plus a uniformly dark batch that does raise gain; this proves shadow compensation preserves bright paper details at the sensor stage as well as in _digital_exposure.
